propositions: Gerrit Verified workflow wall time increased from 15–20 minutes to 30–40 minutes due to combined factors: pytest test count and duration growth (+14m31s measured on macOS), real sleeps and timeouts in unit tests (120s readiness, 25s AST guards, 25s Jira retry, 15s backoff/timeout tests), and xdist per-worker cache fills causing repeated expensive computation.

Mutation testing addition at commit e0b3fdfc8e did not directly cause the regression: only 5 of 62 subsequent runs executed mutation (57 skipped), mutation added zero measured critical-path time, and non-mutation runs averaged 36.5 minutes while active-mutation runs averaged 33.0 minutes.

Six specific unit tests execute expensive mechanics repeatedly or wait on real production clocks unnecessarily: test_live_jira_dc_provisioning waits 120s, test_jira_capability_probe and dependency_audit capture sleeps at import requiring five real 5s waits, test_applier_stale_binding_404 exercises 5xx backoff, test_subcall_class_selection redundantly parses AST four times per run, and test_wiki_render_corpus refills per-worker lru_cache instead of per-session.

macOS runner contention amplifies deterministic test work: across 62 post-mutation runs, macOS queue median was 0.72m (p90 13.53m) and execution median was 27.0m; subprocess/APFS workload becomes nonlinear under contention, not editor startup phases which were measured at max 3.927ms.

Seven remediation tickets were decomposed to address identified slow-tail tests without removing coverage, altering worker count, or increasing aggregate runner usage: fake clock budgets, late-bound sleep injection, AST caching, wiki corpus per-session computation, import_tickets optimization, fixture reuse, and test socket/process timing window reduction.

Root cause is confirmed as a combination of test suite growth (+4.1k tests, ~91k test lines), expensive test mechanics repeated unnecessarily, and xdist per-worker cache behavior under org queueing contention; mutation testing hypothesis was rejected as direct cause.
